purpose: Audit relation, observable end-effector geometry proxy, and action-phase coverage in source-SPI demonstrations without training or evaluation-state access

phase_definition.rule: Before the first positive gripper command is approach; after it until the first later negative command is transport; the remainder is release. Missing boundaries remain unknown.

observable_geometry_proxy.interpretation: End-effector trajectory and proprioception are descriptive observable proxies only; they are not target-relative geometry labels and are not added to the Policy input.
